question: Why is the Mediterranean so geologically complex?
answer: The Mediterranean is not one clean meeting of two plates. Big plates and many microplates move in different directions, so squeezed zones and stretched zones sit side by side and cross.
move: Many plates moving many ways means compression and extension at once.
